question: Where are the śikhā and kavaca limb-mantras to be placed?
premises: The śikhā mantra is placed on the crest.
The kavaca mantra is placed in the middle of the chest.
inference: One should place the śikhā on the crest and the kavaca in the middle of the chest.
plain_english: Having placed the śikhā on the crest, place the kavaca in the middle of the chest.
